brief:
Islamic Jihad warned Wednesday that Israeli occupation policies and escalating crimes in the West Bank will drive the region toward a new round of conflict, Shehab Wire reported. The Palestinian movement asserted that violations of holy sites and sustained attacks against Palestinians would not intimidate the population or deter resistance.

The statement reflected mounting tensions across Palestinian territories as Israeli military operations continued in the West Bank. Islamic Jihad, one of the major armed factions in Palestine, has repeatedly signaled it would respond to what it characterizes as Israeli aggression. The group's warning underscored deep divisions over how to confront Israeli actions in occupied territory.
